verdict.rationale: Attio markets a built-in assistant, "Ask Attio", that searches, updates and creates with AI. It can draft follow-ups, update records, schedule next steps and build account briefs. It can also build workflows from a described goal, and in-product agents (Web, Scoring, Routing, Custom) work on deals. All of this is marketing-page copy with no first-party technical documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the assistant executes delegated tasks (scope, permissions, review/approval), independent or hands-on verification.
